property.name: minutes
property.label: Show every X minutes
property.description: Sets the minutes that has to pass after the popup is shown to the user again

property.name: actions
property.label: Different actions to use
property.description: actions separated by ; of one or multiple. Example: MISSDVS;ACTION1;ACTION2

property.name: disableClose
property.label: Hide close button
property.description: If checked, the user cannot close the component
